title: The Cutting EDG: April 12th, 2021
body:
## Highlights

- EDG [community member Ronald](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/983-ebg-construction-project-wordpress-payment-gateway) proposes to create a [Wordpress payment gateway](https://docs.google.com/document/d/16mjo5dT-fggmhMpilUnYrha2Zh0snisM1MlLWTM7Pb0/edit#heading=h.xvt8ppud2s35) for Edgeware.
- Sean Ford adds the latest revision to EDG [brand identity process discussion](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/975-edgeware-brand-identity-process-updated)
- [Dosto joins Edgeware](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1119-new-validator-in-town-dosto) as a validator
- Richard opens [discussion to research the network state](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1113-research-the-network-state) to bridge the online Edgeware community to the real world
- Manu [opens discussion requesting support for DoinGud](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1109-requesting-support-for-doingud-interoperable-community-owned-marketplace)—an interoperable community owned marketplace
- Richard opens discussion to rethink the [Edgeware grant programme structure](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1110-edgeware-grant-programme-structure-discussion)


## Ecosystem Updates

**Commonwealth.im**
_The multi-chain governance and community interface._
The Commonwealth team has finished v1 for contracts on Commonwealth Protocol. This week and next, they’re testing + auditing the contracts.

**DTrade**
_DTrade is a platform for trading perpetuals and options on Edgeware._No major updates this week, just building.

**Decent Partners**
_Decent is a 'metadao' that seeks to create crypto-native public media._
Decent is onboarding new teams directly to the chain to help remove blocks ahead of decent protocol (e.g. they need basic NFT infra before other stuff can happen). Rich, from Decent Partners, will be posting a phased NFT roadmap strategy outline in the coming days for feedback.
